environment.description: Kubernetes cluster running migration-service in namespace 'platform-services'. The service is exposed via a ClusterIP service and accessed by multiple tenant-management microservices across namespaces (tenant-a-ns, tenant-b-ns, shared-services). Istio sidecar injection is enabled but no AuthorizationPolicy resources are defined. The mesh operates in permissive mode (PeerAuthentication with PERMISSIVE mtls). Any pod in the cluster can reach the migration-service endpoint directly.
